arguments.body: Thanks Olu. Please keep clear of the dripping water and don't touch that light. If you can safely reach your fuse box, switch off the kitchen lights/circuit; if water is near sockets or you feel unsafe, leave and call 999. Move belongings out of the way and take photos.
